title: Grant Programme

provider.name: Foundation of the Berlin House of Representatives

summary: Funding for young researchers from specific countries researching Berlin/German issues or needing access to Berlin research institutions. Includes a pre-doctoral student track (1,100 EUR monthly) and a post-doctoral track.

degree_levels.notes: At least a first higher education qualification; open to pre-doctoral students and post-doctoral researchers (postdoc track is excluded from the student award details).

institutions.notes: Must work on projects requiring access to Berlin research institutions and secure supervision from a higher education lecturer or director of an academic research institution in Berlin.

country_groups: states that once belonged to the Soviet Union / successor states of the Soviet Union
nationality.notes: Restricted to the United States, the United Kingdom, France and states that once belonged to the Soviet Union (specifically listed as Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, France, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States of America, Uzbekistan).

residence.notes: Country is the country in which the applicant is living and from which they are applying.

mandatory.text: At least a first higher education qualification
Commitment by a higher education lecturer or director of an academic research institution in Berlin to provide supervision

funding.description: 1,100 EUR per month for pre-doctoral students over a period of 10 months (post-doctoral researchers receive 1,630 EUR per month). Fixed travel allowance (200 EUR within Europe, 600 EUR outside of Europe).

required_documents.text: Confirmation of supervision by a higher education lecturer or a director of an academic research institution in Berlin

sources.title: Foundation of the Berlin House of Representatives: Grant Programme - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The scholarship funds young researchers, including pre-doctoral students, to conduct research physically in Berlin, Germany.
